name: metagenomic contig taxonomy and abundance
cells:
from Bio import SeqIO
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
contigs = pd.DataFrame([
    {"contig_id": record.id, "length_bp": len(record.seq),
     "gc_fraction": (record.seq.upper().count("G") + record.seq.upper().count("C")) / max(len(record.seq), 1)}
    for record in SeqIO.parse("inputs/contigs.fasta", "fasta")
])
abundance = pd.read_csv("inputs/contig_abundance.tsv", sep="\t")
taxonomy = pd.read_csv("inputs/contig_taxonomy.tsv", sep="\t")
assert contigs["contig_id"].is_unique
assert taxonomy["contig_id"].is_unique
assert abundance["reads"].ge(0).all()

merged = abundance.merge(contigs, on="contig_id", how="left", validate="many_to_one")
merged = merged.merge(taxonomy[["contig_id", "taxon"]], on="contig_id", how="left", validate="many_to_one")
assert merged["length_bp"].notna().all()
merged["taxon"] = merged["taxon"].fillna("unclassified")
taxon_abundance = merged.groupby(["sample_id", "taxon"], as_index=False)["reads"].sum()
sample_totals = taxon_abundance.groupby("sample_id")["reads"].transform("sum")
taxon_abundance["relative_abundance"] = taxon_abundance["reads"].div(sample_totals.replace(0, np.nan)).fillna(0)
merged.to_csv("outputs/merged_contig_table.tsv", sep="\t", index=False)
taxon_abundance.to_csv("outputs/taxon_abundance.tsv", sep="\t", index=False)

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
detected = taxon_abundance.loc[taxon_abundance["reads"] > 0]
summary = detected.groupby("taxon", as_index=False).agg(samples_detected=("sample_id", "nunique"), total_reads=("reads", "sum"))
summary.to_csv("outputs/taxon_summary.tsv", sep="\t", index=False)
plt.figure(figsize=(6, 4))
plt.scatter(contigs["length_bp"] / 1000, contigs["gc_fraction"] * 100, s=8, alpha=0.5)
plt.xlabel("Contig length (kb)")
plt.ylabel("GC (%)")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig("outputs/contig_qc.png", dpi=150)
plt.close()

name: metabolite quality control and principal components
cells:
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
features = pd.read_csv("inputs/metabolite_features.tsv", sep="\t")
metadata = pd.read_csv("inputs/sample_metadata.tsv", sep="\t")
assert features["feature_id"].is_unique
assert metadata["sample_id"].is_unique
sample_ids = [column for column in features.columns if column != "feature_id"]
assert set(sample_ids) <= set(metadata["sample_id"])
matrix = features.set_index("feature_id")[sample_ids].apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce")
assert (matrix.fillna(0).to_numpy() >= 0).all()
missing = matrix.isna().mean(axis=1)
filtered = matrix.loc[missing <= 0.20].copy()
filtered = filtered.loc[filtered.median(axis=1) > 0]
qc = pd.DataFrame({"feature_id": matrix.index, "missing_fraction": missing.to_numpy(), "retained": matrix.index.isin(filtered.index)})
qc.to_csv("outputs/feature_qc.tsv", sep="\t", index=False)

imputed = filtered.T.fillna(filtered.median(axis=1)).T
transformed = np.log1p(imputed)
feature_mean = transformed.mean(axis=1)
feature_sd = transformed.std(axis=1, ddof=1).replace(0, 1)
scaled = transformed.sub(feature_mean, axis=0).div(feature_sd, axis=0)
assert scaled.shape[0] >= 2 and scaled.shape[1] >= 2
assert np.isfinite(scaled.to_numpy()).all()

from sklearn.decomposition import PCA
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
pca = PCA(n_components=2, svd_solver="full")
values = pca.fit_transform(scaled.T)
scores = pd.DataFrame(values, columns=["PC1", "PC2"])
scores.insert(0, "sample_id", sample_ids)
scores = scores.merge(metadata, on="sample_id", how="left", validate="one_to_one")
report = pd.DataFrame({"component": ["PC1", "PC2"], "variance_ratio": pca.explained_variance_ratio_})
scores.to_csv("outputs/pca_scores.tsv", sep="\t", index=False)
report.to_csv("outputs/pca_report.tsv", sep="\t", index=False)
plt.figure(figsize=(6, 4))
plt.scatter(scores["PC1"], scores["PC2"], alpha=0.8)
plt.xlabel("PC1")
plt.ylabel("PC2")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig("outputs/pca_scores.png", dpi=150)
plt.close()
